key.name: enable-switcher
key.description: When off, Alt+Tab goes back to the default GNOME switcher.

key.name: style
key.description: "dark": black background. "desktop": blurred and dimmed wallpaper.

key.name: show-reflection
key.summary: Show the floor reflection under the windows

key.name: tilt-angle
key.summary: Tilt angle of the side windows, in degrees

key.name: side-windows
key.description: Extra windows are stacked behind the last one with lower opacity.

key.name: all-workspaces
key.description: When off, only windows of the current workspace are shown.

key.name: current-monitor-only
key.summary: Show only windows on the monitor where the switcher opens

key.name: light-mode
key.description: Turns off the reflection and the wallpaper blur and flattens the perspective.
